correctness.rationale: Generators g_i=u^(dr-i)v^i span I/mI. For each target grade t<r-1, adjacent syzygies yield uh_(i+1)=vh_i as polynomial identities below truncation. Then u^(dr) divides h_0 of smaller degree, forcing all images zero. Maps into socle Q_(r-1) are all valid. This proves Hom_R(I,Q) is Hom_C(I/mI,soc Q), fixes the character and dimensions. The code independently checks constraints for 30 pairs. The A1 singularity inference uses the established dimension 2N of the underlying reduced Hilbert scheme.

value.rationale: Computes complete first-order deformation spaces, grading and torus weights at canonical fat-vertex ideals in every length of the form N=r+d r(r-1)/2. In the A1 case these exact dimensions expose singularity excess 2r²−1 at all N=r², a local invariant not determined by the reduced scheme dimension. This is a natural geometric locus with a uniform structural proof and localization-relevant representation.
